# Optional App Store "What's New" override. Keep this file comment-only between
# releases so dist/app-store-release-notes.sh derives notes from commits.
#
# To override one release, add `# Release version: x.y.z` and the user-facing
# text below it. The script rejects missing or stale version markers before any
# store upload.
# Release version: 0.2.28

• Direct messages no longer get stuck loading on phones, and the conversation's calls, pins, notifications and encryption options now sit in one labelled ⋮ menu.
• Set up encrypted chats on a new device by approving it from one you already use and comparing a code — no backup to copy.
• Remove a lost device from Encryption & backup → Manage devices; it can no longer read new encrypted messages. (Device approval needs Accord Server 0.2.5.)
